speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari
text: asked	the Minister for Finance whether IRAS will allow Singaporeans who are retrenched due to the economic downturn this year to defer their income tax payment till they are able to find employment.

speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: In serious cases of financial difficulty, will IRAS consider reducing or waiving the person's tax liability?
